relationships.subject: visual cortex astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: activating cortical astrocytes was sufficient to induce prolonged ongoing discharge and mechanical sensitization of meningeal nociceptors

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-CGRP mAb prevented the astrocyte-related meningeal nociceptor activation when compared to pretreatment with the isotype control mAb

relationships.subject: visual cortex astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: Following astrocyte stimulation, we observed reduced mechanical pain thresholds for at least 4 h post-CNO administration in both sexes

key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of visual cortex astrocytes drives meningeal nociceptor discharge, mechanical sensitization and migraine-like behaviors without inducing CSD.
Anti-CGRP mAb blocked astrocyte-driven nociceptor activation and reduced hypersensitivity but not mechanical sensitization of nociceptors.
